title: Qualify narrowband amateur experiments
description: Evaluate ordinary bidirectional narrow-BW LoRa on exact SX1262/LR1110/board variants separately from LR-FHSS. Verify driver support (current Zephyr bandwidth enum is not all silicon bandwidths), LDRO, SF/header/CRC, RF switching/calibration, retune/settling, receive deadlines and oscillator offset/drift over long packets. Use corrected SF10 airtime:31.25kHz/255B11.149312s and10B1.155072s; never claim400ms fragments by excluding preamble/authentication. Part97 qualification must identify station/control operator, emission classification, geography, identification, control/shutdown, permitted traffic and SS10WPEP limit where applicable. Human review must resolve OSCORE confidentiality versus message-obscuring restrictions; do not weaken production security or pick a licensing fallback. No physical ports or RF work before bench safety and explicit operational authorization.
acceptance_criteria: Exact qualified configuration and authoritative rule sources; independent airtime/bitrate vectors and actual oscillator/retune/CPU/RF measurements distinguished; station call sign/control and power/emission constraints demonstrated where authorized. No blanket1500W/all-legal/TCXO-guarantees-accuracy claim. Research outcome may be no-go; no new normative PHY or automatic enablement.
